title: CrAnvil
description: Crashing Anvil! A Datapack to bring back the anvils destroying items!
body:
# CrAnvil (Crushing Anvil)
A Datapack to bring back the anvils destroying items!


# What it does
This datapack is very simple. It only ensures that anvils destroy objects when they land on them!
Thats all!


# How to use
Just install the datapack and put it in the datapack folder of your minecraft world. Then when you start your world you will see a message that proves the datapack is loaded!


## P.S.
The explosion in the logo does not take place when you use the datapack in the game. I was just trying to visualize the effect of the anvils crushing the items.

I also don't know what pictures to upload that describe the datapack better than the sentence: Anvils destroy items!
